answers.goal: My ultimate goal in entertainment is easily summed up in the title show runner. I work interdisciplinary though, so I would love to create IP projects.
answers.drew: I love the collaboration within the entertainment industry, and all the work people do in order to bring stories to life. No matter the kinds of projects, dramas, comedies or even superhero films it is always amazing to see how others view the world and the ways they come up with to express their interests.
answers.seeking: I am looking to connect with writers, photographers/ cinematographers, and overall people who want to create big worlds.
answers.inspiration: I am really inspired by Regina King. King works as an actress, director and voice artist. Every role I have seen her in has been impactful to me personally and collectively for the black community.
